monitor_the_situation.title: Iran Launches Missiles at US Base in Jordan
— S3 · Conflict · Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, Jordan · 32m ago. Iran launched ballistic missiles toward Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan, which hosts US forces, according to a senior American official.
Iran Launches Multiple Ballistic Missiles From Several Regions

— S3 · Conflict · Iran · 54m ago. Iran launched multiple ballistic missiles from several regions, including at least one from Khomein in Markazi Province. The intended targets remain unknown, raising regional tensions.
Israeli Artillery Pounds Nabatieh al-Fawqa in Southern Lebanon
— S3 · Conflict · Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Lebanon · 2h ago. Israeli forces shelled areas around Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon amid ongoing cross-border tensions with Hezbollah.
